journey.name: onchain send activity confirmation
journey.description: Verifies that one accepted Savings payment keeps one activity entry through wallet sync, confirmation and restart, with the selected contact and fee preserved. Preconditions: two owned regtest wallets linked as contacts, a synced sending wallet with at least 6,000 confirmed sats, and access to the configured regtest backend's block-mining helper. Keep both apps running.

actions.action: On the receiving wallet, create a fresh 5,000-sat payment request for the sending contact
On the sending wallet, open the received payment request and tap Pay
Tap Show details, then select Savings if Spending is selected
Verify the review shows 5,000 sats, Savings and the receiving contact; record the fee
Swipe the send handle fully to the right and wait for Bitcoin Sent
Open Details and record the payment's date and time, then open Explore and record the exact transaction ID from TXID

Return to the sending wallet's activity list and verify exactly one new outgoing entry shows the total amount of 5,000 sats plus the recorded fee, with the receiving contact; an unconfirmed row shows a confirmation estimate instead of the payment time
Open that outgoing entry, then Explore
Verify TXID matches the recorded transaction ID
Mine one regtest block with ./lsp POST /regtest/chain/mine '{"count":1}' from the Android checkout, using the same backend as both wallets; a successful command exits with status 0 and prints nothing
Return from Explore to the activity details and wait for the status to become Confirmed
Verify the details preserve the receiving contact, 5,000-sat recipient amount and recorded fee
Return to the activity list and verify exactly one outgoing entry has the recorded payment time and total amount, with the receiving contact
Open that outgoing entry, then Explore
Verify TXID matches the recorded transaction ID
Restart the sending app normally, open its activity list and wait for the contact profiles to load
Verify exactly one outgoing entry has the recorded payment time and total amount, with the receiving contact
Open that outgoing entry and verify its status is Confirmed and it preserves the contact, 5,000-sat recipient amount and recorded fee, then open Explore
Verify TXID matches the recorded transaction ID
